title: Row Insertion and Returning Generated IDs with RETURNING
realWorldScenario: An Express.js API creates a new customer and immediately needs the newly generated auto-incrementing ID to create an initial order.
questionStatement: How does the PostgreSQL-specific `RETURNING` clause work with `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE`? Why is it superior to executing a secondary `SELECT LASTVAL()` query?
hints: Append RETURNING id at the end of an INSERT statement.
